CPRRollTracker.Title: d10 Roll Tracker
CPRRollTracker.GMScope: Game Masters can see statistics for every user.
CPRRollTracker.PlayerScope: Only your own statistics are shown.
CPRRollTracker.ClearConfirm: Clear all retained rolls for {name}? This cannot be undone.
CPRRollTracker.NoData: There are no tracked rolls in this view.
CPRRollTracker.Note: Each check records its initial d10 face before modifiers and any critical follow-up die. The retained history and the combat subset begin when the module is enabled.
CPRRollTracker.PermissionError: Players can only access their own roll statistics.

Settings.MaxRollsHint: Older rolls are discarded when a user's retained history reaches this limit.
Settings.CountBlindHint: If disabled, blind rolls made by players are not added to their statistics. A Game Master's own blind rolls are always counted.
Settings.StreakVisibilityHint: Choose whether close-result streaks are disabled, whispered to Game Masters, or posted publicly. A streak containing a blind roll is always whispered.
Settings.StreakThresholdHint: The number of consecutive d10 results within one point of each other required to announce a streak.
